_note: Named finds (F10 D1, decision 0410): rare pieces that belong to someone a region knows, one copy each. Each is always the same piece (`slot`, `rarity`, `seed`, `name`, `line`) with its own `ability`, found on nothing else, shaped like an extra effect (parts.json `extras`): `field` and `lo` give its number, `as` makes it a multiplier. It comes from `drops` (a fight group, at `chance` a win, until it's owned), a `box` (a container kind in an area, optionally `near` a spot within `within` units and once `flags` are set), or `given` (a scene gives it with the gear effect `{ "find": id }`). `riddle` shows on the Finds page until it's found. `obed` is what Obed says when it's found with him in the party. Every new region adds its own (CLAUDE.md, docs/15-regions.md).

finds.name: Granddad Reed's Wall Gloves
finds.line: Worn through at the right palm. He could set a wall stone one-handed.
finds.riddle: Where the orchard meets the old wall, the frost keeps what one hand built.

ability.name: Set a stone
ability.text: Each earth hit you land makes the next blow on you {less:mul} softer.

finds.name: Jotham Tuttle's Tower Boots
finds.line: Sixty years up the tower stairs to the church clock. Worn at the toes, from the climbing.
finds.riddle: Among the stones of the dead, look for feet that climbed to the clock.

ability.name: The clock strikes
ability.tag: Every third round: first, and free
ability.text: Every third round, like a clock striking, you act before everyone, and that move costs nothing.

finds.name: Mercy Whitcomb's Shawl
finds.line: Mercy Whitcomb's. It stayed in the cedar chest when the family went down the river.
finds.riddle: When the Burying Ground goes dim, cedar keeps what went downriver.

ability.name: Kept in cedar
ability.text: Once a fight, the first affliction that would land on you lands on nothing.

finds.name: The Dunns' Key Belt
finds.line: A key for every room, the bishop's too. None of the doors has been locked in years.
finds.riddle: Split wood behind the inn, and a door that's never locked may open.

ability.name: A key for every room
ability.tag: Your food feeds the weakest friend too
ability.text: Food or drink you take also does its good for the friend with the least health.

finds.name: Grandfather Strand's Calked Boots
finds.line: Calks worn flat. He walked every log in this camp and told his boy to leave the pine.
finds.riddle: Fell the one who fells, and a logger's boots may walk free.

ability.name: Sure-footed
ability.tag: First lost turn each fight: kept
ability.text: The first time a foe would make you lose your turn, you keep your footing.

finds.name: Old Lamb's Drover Coat
finds.line: Hosea's father's. He kept the flock this side of the wall, and he was usually right about cold.
finds.riddle: Where the wall's breath turns cold, a shepherd's coat still waits.

ability.name: Keeps the flock
ability.text: Frost blows aimed at a friend come to you instead, {less:mul} softer.

finds.name: Obadiah Thayer's Mittens
finds.obed: Great-grandfather's. Whoever darned these never laid a wall.
finds.riddle: Below a mark cut in quarried stone, the hardest stone keeps darned thumbs.

ability.name: Laid the Thayer way
ability.tag: Three earth hits: the next strikes twice
ability.text: Each earth hit you land adds a stone. At the third, your next earth move strikes twice.

finds.name: Phebe Thayer's Herb Pouch
finds.line: Phebe Thayer's. There's sage in the pocket yet.
finds.riddle: Help a waller with his wall, and he may part with something kept.

ability.name: Sage in it yet
ability.text: Once a fight, when a friend drops below a quarter of their health, you tend them for {pc:pct} of it, without spending your turn.

finds.name: The Pikes' Store Coat
finds.line: PIKE chalked inside the collar, in the same hand as the crate.
finds.riddle: Finish what the crate began, then look beside it.

ability.name: The Pikes bite
ability.text: Whoever hits you is Marked, and everyone's hits on them land harder.

finds.name: The Letterer's Mallet
finds.line: Left on the sill of the last hollow, head down.
finds.riddle: At the end of the Seam, on a sill, something put down for the night.

ability.name: The letterer's hand
ability.tag: Each crit: next {pc:critAdd} likelier; last in round 1
ability.text: Each critical hit makes your next one {pc:critAdd} likelier, all fight long; but you act last in the first round.

finds.name: Ezekiel Rowe's Bark Spud
finds.line: Worn to the shape of his hand, and sharp.
finds.riddle: Where the bark is stacked to dry, the tool that took it off.

ability.name: Peeled
ability.tag: First hit on each foe strips its guard
ability.text: Your first hit on each foe strips any guard it has up: a Defend, a Curl, a shield.

finds.name: Lydia Fairbanks's Nutting Apron
finds.line: Six pockets, and every one has a beechnut in the seam.
finds.riddle: Help a mother home with her harvest, and see what she can spare.

ability.name: Mast year
ability.text: Once a fight, when you fell a foe, you eat a beechnut and heal {pc:pct} of your health.

finds.name: The Night Man's Cup
finds.riddle: The cup that hangs where everyone drinks and no one owns it.

ability.name: Full by morning
ability.tag: First Drowsy or Frightened each fight: kept off
ability.text: The first time each fight you would be Drowsy or Frightened, you aren't.

finds.name: Jotham Leavitt's Teamster Coat
finds.riddle: Behind the one who blocks the road, a wagon waits; the driver keeps his coat on the seat.

ability.name: Hauled
ability.tag: Takes blows meant for a friend below half health
ability.text: While a friend is below half their health, blows aimed at them come to you instead.
